pages.title: Salt Generation
pages.text: Salt generation is controlled by both the Growthcraft config and a gamerule saved with each world.$(br2)Both must allow generation. The gamerule defaults to ON; it cannot override a disabled config.

pages.title: Creating a World
pages.text: Before creating a world, open $(bold)Game Rules$() and scroll to $(bold)World Updates$().$(br2)Set $(bold)Generate Growthcraft salt ore$() to OFF to prevent salt generation from the start. Click Done to keep your choice.

pages.title: Existing Worlds
pages.text: The rule is saved with the world and applies to the Overworld, Nether and End.$(br2)Changes affect newly generated chunks. Existing ore remains. Worlds without a saved rule default to ON.

pages.title: Gamerule Command
pages.text: With cheats or operator permission, disable generation with:$(br2)/gamerule growthcraftSaltGeneration false$(br2)Use true to allow it again, provided the config also allows it.

pages.title: Server Config
pages.text: Edit $(bold)growthcraft-common.toml$() in the config folder while the game or server is stopped.$(br2)Under $(bold)[worldgen]$(), set $(bold)saltOreGenEnabled$() to false to disable Growthcraft salt generation regardless of the world rule.

pages.title: Amount and Height
pages.text: Under $(bold)[worldgen]$():$(br2)$(bold)saltOreGenVeinSize$(): vein size parameter (default 5).$(br2)$(bold)saltOreGenSpreadAmount$(): placement attempts per chunk (default 10).$(br2)Actual ore counts vary with terrain. Lower these values for less salt.

pages.title: Height Range
pages.text: $(bold)saltOreGenHeightMin$() and $(bold)saltOreGenHeightMax$() set the Y range for placement attempts.$(br2)Defaults are -32 and 64. Minimum must not exceed maximum; an inverted range skips generation.

pages.title: Salt Variants
pages.text: The config also controls generation in the Nether and End, and whether deepslate can contain salt.$(br2)Disabling deepslate salt still allows stone salt in the Overworld. These switches are under $(bold)[worldgen]$().
